hpi: A 25-year-old male presented with a rash on his palms and soles with a history of sexual encounters that were not protected. The patient was diagnosed with secondary syphilis based on the clinical findings and serological tests. Syphilis is a sexually transmitted infection that can present with a variety of symptoms, including rashes, and it is important to obtain a thorough sexual history to guide diagnosis and treatment. The patient was treated with Benzathine penicillin G, and follow-up was arranged to ensure resolution of symptoms.
